message.content:
The largest planet that has been confirmed in the observable universe is **HD 100546 b**.  
It orbits the young star HD 100546 and has a radius of roughly **2.5 – 3 times that of Jupiter** (about 30,000 km). Its mass is estimated to be around 10 – 15 Jupiter masses, placing it at the upper end of the planetary mass range before it would be classified as a brown dwarf.  

So, as of now, HD 100546 b holds the record for the biggest planet we know of.
